card.name: Words right after "imagine" scenarios
card.fires_on: The word right after "imagine" (or a similar hypothetical lead-in), most often "having" or "trying". It also fires on later words inside the imagined scenario, such as "your" or "with".

modes.label: Imagine + -ing verb
modes.description: The -ing verb (having, trying) directly after "imagine" opens a hypothetical scenario.
modes.example: But imagine<< having>> limitless sources of energy.

modes.label: Inside the imagined scenario
modes.description: A word a little further into a hypothetical or "what if" scene.
modes.example: Honey bees hurting Imagine having 1/3 of<< your>> corn and soybean yields erased every year

card.plain: It lights up on the first words of a "just imagine this" scenario, especially "having" after "imagine".
